recipes.title: Pecan Pie
recipes.note: From Grandma Maude Pauline Herod (DAR)'s handwritten recipe card.
steps: Mix all ingredients for the filling together, adding the pecans last.
Pour into the pastry shell.
Bake in a 400°F (hot) oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 350°F (moderate) and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer.
When the pie is done, the outer edge of the filling should be set and the center slightly soft.

recipes.title: Potato Cake
recipes.note: From a handwritten recipe card. The card lists ingredients and an oven temperature only, with no mixing directions or baking time, and the sugar amount is hard to read.
ingredients: Sugar (amount hard to read on the card, looks like 2 cups)
1/2 teaspoon each cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg
steps: Bake at 350 degrees. (The card doesn't give a time.)

recipes.title: Devil Food Cake
recipes.note: From Grandma Maude Pauline Herod (DAR)'s handwritten recipes. The photo cuts off right at "Bake", so the oven temperature and time are still to be added.
steps: Cream the sugar and Crisco. Add the eggs and beat until fluffy.
Sift together the flour, salt and cocoa.
Add the soda with the milk and beat.
Add the vanilla and the boiling water. Beat until smooth.
Pour into five layer pans. Bake (the rest of this line is cut off in the photo).

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup (do not add water or milk)
1 small bag of French fried onions
steps: Spread the green beans into a 9x13 casserole dish.
Melt the cheese with the soup and pour over the green beans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Spread the French fried onions on top and bake another 5-10 minutes.
To double it, just double the ingredients.

recipes.title: Taco Turnovers
recipes.note: Kids favorite, great with sour cream!
steps: Cook the ground beef.
Fill the croissants with the mixture.
Add shredded cheese on top.
Bake at 375 for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Manicotti
recipes.note: The recipe says to put pasta sauce (meat sauce) on top of the manicotti. Use meat sauce or plain pasta sauce, as you like.
ingredients: Half a tablespoon pepper (crushed red pepper if desired)
Pasta sauce (for the dish and the top)
Another 3 ounces mozzarella cheese (for the top)
steps: Mix together the ricotta, Parmesan, mozzarella, garlic, parsley, pepper and salt.
Boil the manicotti noodles for only seven minutes (or al dente).
Stuff the cheese mixture inside the noodles.
Put pasta sauce in a 9 x 13 baking dish, then place the filled manicotti in the dish.
Put pasta sauce (meat sauce) on top of the manicotti.
Put another 3 ounces of mozzarella on top, and another 3 ounces of Parmesan on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 375 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Crockpot Fiesta Chicken
ingredients: 1 oz. packet fiesta Hidden Valley Ranch Mix
15.25 oz. can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Add the chicken breasts to the crockpot.
Sprinkle over the ranch packet.
Add the drained corn, drained beans, Rotel, onion, and place the cream cheese block on top.
Cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or HIGH for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken and stir when done.
Serve with tortilla chips or tortillas.

recipes.title: Mimi's Lemon Cheesecake Bars
recipes.note: Typed from Mimi's handwritten card (photo shown). Easy to fix, and Mimi made these for Easter.
ingredients: 2/3 C. (5 oz can) Carnation evaporated milk
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Combine the flour and powdered sugar in a medium bowl. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until crumbly. Press into the bottom and 1 inch up the sides of an ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan. Bake 25 minutes.
Place the cream cheese, eggs, evaporated milk, granulated sugar, flour, lemon juice, lemon peel and food coloring in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Pour into the partially baked crust.
Bake 15 minutes or until set. Cool on a wire rack.
Spread the sour cream over the top. Refrigerate, then cut into bars.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 2/3 cup Kikkoman Roasted Garlic Teriyaki Marinade & Sauce
steps: Combine the teriyaki sauce, brown sugar and oil, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the mixture over the chicken in a large plastic food storage bag. Press the air out and close the top securely. Turn the bag over several times to coat the chicken.
Refrigerate 2 hours, turning the bag over once.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and discard the marinade.
Grill the chicken 4 to 5 inches from hot coals 12 to 15 minutes, or until no longer pink in the center, turning over occasionally.

recipes.title: Torta Italiano
recipes.note: Layered turkey, spinach and cheese bake from Mimi's cookbook page (photos shown). It uses ground turkey, which the planner has no toggle for, so pick it from the family recipe slot on any day.
ingredients: 1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 cup (4 ounces) shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
1/2 ounce fresh Parmesan cheese, grated (about 2 tablespoons)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly spray a springform pan with vegetable oil.
Combine the baking mix and milk. Roll the dough evenly over the flat bottom of the pan.
Cook the turkey, onion and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat 8-10 minutes, or until the turkey is no longer pink. Drain.
Sprinkle with the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Stir in the tomato sauce. Reduce the heat to low and simmer 5 minutes.
Spread the turkey mixture over the dough. Top evenly with the spinach, then the mozzarella, then grate the Parmesan over the top.
Bake 30-35 minutes. Remove from the oven and cool 10 minutes.
Run a knife gently around the inside of the pan collar before removing. Cut into 8 wedges and serve.
